invariants.rationale: The metadata parameter must be non-null to call methods on it safely.
The getWriteStatuses method should return a non-null HoodieData object representing write statuses.
The collection of write statuses must be valid and non-null to pass to clone.
The count of write statuses is always zero or positive, indicating a valid data state.
The count of statuses equals the size of the collected list, ensuring data consistency.
